registers.name: CFG_WINDOW
registers.description: 64-bit compact configuration window. Firmware writes capture mode enable, watchdog limit, freshness limit, command clamp bounds, geometry descriptor ID, control profile selection, and hold-last-good policy. Firmware reads return the same window fields and any readable mirrored status/debug bits defined by the RTL implementation.

fields.name: MODE_ENABLE
fields.description: Enables request issuance and response supervision when set.

fields.name: HOLD_LAST_GOOD_ENABLE
fields.description: When set, permits the controller to retain the last known good command on fault instead of forcing deterministic fallback.

fields.name: WATCHDOG_LIMIT
fields.description: Maximum request-to-acceptance age in controller clock cycles before timeout handling is forced.

fields.name: FRESHNESS_LIMIT
fields.description: Maximum allowable response age for freshness acceptance.

fields.name: CMD_MIN_BOUND
fields.description: Lower 16-bit packed command bound used by firmware-visible configuration. The RTL maps this field into the internal 32-bit clamp register convention as implementation-defined sign/zero extension consistent with the chosen command encoding.

fields.name: CMD_MAX_BOUND
fields.description: Upper 16-bit packed command bound used by firmware-visible configuration. The RTL maps this field into the internal 32-bit clamp register convention as implementation-defined sign/zero extension consistent with the chosen command encoding.

registers.name: CFG_EXT0
registers.description: Extended configuration window for compact metadata not fully represented in CFG_WINDOW.

fields.name: GEOMETRY_DESCRIPTOR_ID
fields.description: Compact geometry descriptor identifier inserted into outbound request packets.

fields.name: PROFILE_SELECTOR
fields.description: Control profile selector used in request packaging and fallback profile selection.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved for future compact configuration expansion; reads as zero.

registers.name: STATUS_WINDOW
registers.description: 64-bit status/readback window containing busy, request_pending, response_valid, stale_detected, timeout_detected, clamp_applied, fallback_active, fault_latched, and auxiliary debug bits.

fields.name: STATUS_BUSY
fields.description: Controller is actively supervising an outstanding transaction or executing fallback/timeout handling.

fields.name: STATUS_REQUEST_PENDING
fields.description: A request has been issued or is pending handshake/response completion.

fields.name: STATUS_RESPONSE_VALID
fields.description: A response has been validated and accepted for command processing.

fields.name: STATUS_STALE_DETECTED
fields.description: A stale, duplicated, or out-of-order response was detected.

fields.name: STATUS_TIMEOUT_DETECTED
fields.description: The watchdog timeout condition was detected.

fields.name: STATUS_CLAMP_APPLIED
fields.description: Final command required clamping to fit within configured bounds.

fields.name: STATUS_FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Deterministic fallback command behavior is currently active.

fields.name: STATUS_FAULT_LATCHED
fields.description: Fault has been latched due to invalid, stale, malformed, or late response conditions.

fields.name: REQUEST_TAG
fields.description: Current outstanding request tag for transaction matching and stale detection.

fields.name: OUTSTANDING_AGE
fields.description: Aging counter for the current outstanding request in clock cycles.

fields.name: LAST_GOOD_CMD_LO
fields.description: Lower 16 bits of the last known good command, exposed for software observability.

fields.name: LAST_GOOD_CMD_HI
fields.description: Upper 8 bits of the last known good command, exposed for software observability.

registers.name: REQUEST_STATUS
registers.description: Request-side observability for host coordination with the external surrogate service.

fields.name: REQ_VALID_OUT
fields.description: Outbound request valid currently asserted by the RTL.

fields.name: REQ_READY_IN
fields.description: External request-ready handshake as sampled by the RTL.

fields.name: RSP_VALID_IN
fields.description: External response valid currently observed by the RTL.

fields.name: RSP_READY_OUT
fields.description: Response ready driven by the RTL back to the external service.

fields.name: REQUEST_ISSUED
fields.description: Internal request issuance pulse observed for software status correlation.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: FAULT_CLEAR
registers.description: Write-one-to-clear fault and status latches. Safety-critical state remains synchronous and may reassert if the fault condition persists.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULT_LATCH
fields.description: Writing 1 clears the latched fault state when the underlying condition is no longer present.

fields.name: CLEAR_STALE_FLAG
fields.description: Writing 1 clears the stale-detected status latch.

fields.name: CLEAR_TIMEOUT_FLAG
fields.description: Writing 1 clears the timeout-detected status latch.

fields.name: CLEAR_CLAMP_FLAG
fields.description: Writing 1 clears the clamp-applied sticky indication if implemented as latched status.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: COMMAND_OBSERVE
registers.description: Readback of the final actuator command and selected auxiliary command state.

fields.name: ACT_CMD_VALID
fields.description: Final actuator command valid indicator.

fields.name: ACT_CMD_READY
fields.description: Observed actuator ready handshake input.

fields.name: ACT_CMD_DATA_LO
fields.description: Lower 16 bits of the final actuator command.

fields.name: ACT_CMD_DATA_HI
fields.description: Upper 16 bits of the final actuator command.

fields.name: FALLBACK_PROFILE_SEL
fields.description: Current fallback profile selection observed by the controller.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved.

registers.name: REQ_PACKET_LO
registers.description: Lower 64 bits of the most recently launched 128-bit request packet for firmware observability.

fields.name: REQ_PACKET_LO
fields.description: Lower half of the request packet. The exact field packing is RTL-defined but remains bounded and compact.

registers.name: REQ_PACKET_HI
registers.description: Upper 64 bits of the most recently launched 128-bit request packet for firmware observability.

fields.name: REQ_PACKET_HI
fields.description: Upper half of the request packet. The exact field packing is RTL-defined but remains bounded and compact.

sources.name: FAULT_LATCHED_IRQ
sources.description: Asserted when a fault is latched due to invalid, stale, malformed, duplicated, out-of-order, or late response handling.

sources.name: TIMEOUT_IRQ
sources.description: Asserted when the watchdog limit is exceeded and timeout handling is entered.

sources.name: REQUEST_ISSUED_IRQ
sources.description: Optional pulse-style notification that a compact request packet has been launched for the external surrogate service.

init_sequence: Hold reset asserted, then deassert reset_n synchronously.
Program CFG_WINDOW with MODE_ENABLE=0 while loading WATCHDOG_LIMIT and FRESHNESS_LIMIT.
Program command bounds, geometry descriptor ID, profile selector, and HOLD_LAST_GOOD_ENABLE through CFG_WINDOW and CFG_EXT0.
Clear any stale status by writing 1s to FAULT_CLEAR fields as needed.
Set MODE_ENABLE=1 after configuration is stable.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS_WINDOW for STATUS_REQUEST_PENDING, STATUS_RESPONSE_VALID, STATUS_STALE_DETECTED, STATUS_TIMEOUT_DETECTED, STATUS_FALLBACK_ACTIVE, STATUS_FAULT_LATCHED, and STATUS_CLAMP_APPLIED.
Optionally read REQ_PACKET_LO/HI and REQUEST_STATUS to debug outbound request content and handshake state.
If fault or timeout is reported, write FAULT_CLEAR to clear sticky indicators after the external condition is resolved.
irq_sequence: On FAULT_LATCHED_IRQ or TIMEOUT_IRQ, stop issuing new requests until software has observed the fault context and, if appropriate, adjusted configuration or cleared the fault.
On REQUEST_ISSUED_IRQ, correlate the launch event with external service handling of the same request semantics.
After handling the event, resume polling STATUS_WINDOW until the controller returns to a ready state.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
No new hierarchy or ports were invented.
The register map uses the abstract firmware-visible register window implied by the spec and preserves the required 64-bit configuration/status access contract.
Wider values are exposed only via split registers or bounded readbacks, not as wide external pins.
